evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ and updates RPC output handling in src/rpc/rawtransaction_util.cpp, src/rpc/blockchain.cpp, and src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp.
rationale: Addresses a long-standing user request to avoid client-side workarounds when inspecting P2SH/P2WSH inputs. As noted in issue #27391, callers previously had to manually extract raw byte pushes from scriptSig or witness stacks and run separate decoding calls to inspect redeem and witness scripts.
